name: China CITIC Bank Corporation Limited
summary: China CITIC Bank Corporation Limited provides various banking products and services in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It operates in three segments: Corporate Banking, Retail Banking, and Financial Market business. The Corporate Banking segment offers corporate loans, deposit services, agency services, money transfer and settlement services, and guarantee services to corporate clients, government agencies, and non-financial institutions. Its Retail Banking segment provides personal loans, deposit services, agency services, remittance and settlement services, and guarantee services to individual customers.
